text:
katie_prod: FYA - onboarding sample app showing weird parity between SDKs for embeddings/rerank. Node and Rust SDKs sometimes return an extra null/empty vector in batch responses under auth churn. Python OK.

omar_sdk: Can you paste a minimal repro and whether you used the sampleapp's batcher helper?

katie_prod: Using sampleapp batcher. Minimal POST to embeddings/batch with two inputs. If a token refresh happens during the request, response sometimes comes back like: { "results": [ {"embedding": [0.1,...] }, null ] } or occasionally { "results": [ null, {"embedding": [...] } ] }. No explicit error.

lucy_onboard: I saw this too when migrating a customer onboarding flow. The UX impact is that stored document vectors can be empty and then downstream retriever returns bad results.

omar_sdk: Sounds like a zipper bug in client: when retry wrapper replays fragments after auth refresh, the client maps results by index and inserts placeholders for missing slots. Server-side merges can result in out-of-order or missing items.

katie_prod: Repro steps: I force token expiry and fire a batched request. Repro rate ~15% on my laptop without throttling. Single curl never fails, only SDK batcher.

omar_sdk: Quick mitigation I'll push: make batcher annotate each input with a stable client_id (nanoid) and have the client reassemble by client_id. Also add fail-safe that if any result is null/empty, retry the entire batch once.

lucy_onboard: Is there an API mismatch contributing? We found embeddings return "embedding" while rerank returns "vector" in some responses which confused some mapping code.

omar_sdk: Good point. I'll make the SDK zipper tolerant to both field names and normalize to "vector" internally. Also adding verbose debug logs on mismatched lengths.

infra-bot: NOTE: Filed INFRA-912 - singleflight auth refresh + retry semantics. Also flagged potential server-side validation to reject fragment merges that lack client_ids.

omar_sdk: Patch pushed to sdk-node: wrap inputs as { client_id, payload } and map by client_id on response. Local smoke (5k runs forcing token refresh) showed zero nulls. Draft PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/sdk-node/pulls/1327

katie_prod: Verified patched sampleapp and node SDK in staging. No missing vectors. Moving to longer soak.

lucy_onboard: I'll update onboarding docs: add a troubleshooting entry under "Embeddings/Rerank - empty vectors" suggesting BATCHER_CLIENT_ID=true and SDK upgrade. Filing DOCS-533.

omar_sdk: Follow-ups: 1) add integration test in sampleapp CI that simulates token refresh mid-batch; 2) normalize response field names in API docs and discuss RFC for endpoint parity; 3) consider server-side error if fragment merge would create holes without client_ids.

katie_prod: Thanks all. Tag me on the PR and docs ticket. Leaving thread. :thumbsup:
